note: SFT-vs-DPO comparison on a small local model. All arms: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 Q4_K_M via Ollama, num_ctx 8192, num_predict 2048, workflow system prompt (baselines/prompt_c.txt), task prompt 0.3.5, max_turns 30, eval split (seeds >= 1,000,000). Provider errors (malformed tool-call args, context overflow) are serving/infra failures per docs/DESIGN.md decision 11, not agent failures; reported separately.

env.oracle: provided executable is runnable during work, deleted before grading; subprocesses blocked in grading sandbox
env.deliverable: one editable file per family (solution.py / keygen.py / parser.py)

model_lineage.sft: LoRA r=32, train_on_responses_only, ~360-405 solved-teacher episodes (deepseek-flash + swe2), 2-3 epochs, lr 1e-4
model_lineage.dpo: 1 epoch DPOTrainer on top of the SFT LoRA, beta 0.1, lr 5e-5, 129 pairs (69 real + 60 sampled synthetic early-quit), ref = frozen SFT policy

datasets.sft: sft/train_v2_c.jsonl (405 rows: deepseek + 45 swe2 formats solves)
datasets.dpo_real: sft/dpo_v1.jsonl (81 pairs at eval time; pilot trained on the 69-pair version + 60 of 121 synthetic)

eval_cells.caveat: run truncated early; solve had a host artifact-save error (WinError), unverified

collection_runs_train_seeds.purpose: base-model rejection harvesting (18 pairs added to dpo_v1)

findings: DPO pilot: decompile L0 3/20, keygen L0 8/20 on held-out seeds vs SFT arms ~1/12 eval combined and base 0/30. Suggestive, not conclusive at this n.
Failure modes persist post-DPO: max_turns loops (9/20 decompile, 11/20 keygen) and provider errors (malformed tool-call JSON, context overflow at 8192) remain the dominant loss sources.
DPO reduced early-quit/fake-verification relative to v3c's decompile cell (v3c: 2 max_turns + quit + errors in 5; dpo episodes run to the cap more often and convert more).
Malformed tool-call args and context overflows are serving issues (Q4_K_M + llama-server tool parsing + 8k ctx), unaffected by preference training as expected.

Transcript spot-check (4 solves read end-to-end): rewards are real - write, differential-test vs oracle, fix, re-verify, stop. Residual pathology: post-solve looping to max_turns (8/11 solves); e.g. keygen seed 1000007 solved then ran a broken self-check passing a literal f-string as the serial 34x until the cap. DPO improved conversion, not termination.
